findings.requirement: Search matches partial queries across every user-visible work-item field.
findings.behavior: Search now excludes owner and note fields and uses startsWith instead of partial matching.
findings.impact: Queries matching text in owner, note, or the middle/end of a field return no results.
findings.reproduction: Search for a substring that is not at the beginning of an item's name or summary, or search for an owner or note value.
findings.recommendation: Include all user-visible fields, including owner and note, and use case-insensitive includes matching.

findings.requirement: A specific status selection includes only items with that exact status, while All includes every workflow status.
findings.behavior: Any non-All status selection includes every status except Blocked rather than matching the selected status.
findings.impact: Selecting a specific status shows unrelated workflow items and omits Blocked items.
findings.reproduction: Select a status such as In Progress while the dataset contains items in other non-Blocked statuses.
findings.recommendation: Compare item.status directly with filters.status for specific selections, retaining All as the unrestricted case.

findings.requirement: Risk scoring preserves due-today urgency and blocked-item weighting.
findings.behavior: Blocked items receive no status weighting, and due-today urgency is reduced from 24 to 12 while the same value is also applied to items due within two days.
findings.impact: Blocked and due-today work is materially under-scored, potentially changing prioritization and risk labels.
findings.reproduction: Calculate risk for a blocked item and compare it with an otherwise identical non-blocked item; compare dueInDays 0 with dueInDays 3.
findings.recommendation: Retain explicit blocked weighting and the original due-today urgency behavior, with separate handling for other due dates.

findings.requirement: Summary metrics count both blocked and escalated work.
findings.behavior: The summary metric counts only Escalated items.
findings.reproduction: Summarize a portfolio containing at least one Blocked item and one Escalated item; the metric equals one instead of two.
findings.recommendation: Count items whose status is Blocked or Escalated.

findings.requirement: The queue shows every matching item unless pagination is explicitly introduced.
findings.behavior: The queue always truncates the input to the first five items without pagination controls or an explicit pagination mechanism.
findings.impact: Matching items after the fifth are invisible to users.
findings.reproduction: Provide six or more matching work items and observe that only the first five render.
findings.recommendation: Render all matching items, or introduce explicit pagination with controls and state before limiting the list.
